item.title: Fast Company
item.description: After his sponser betrays him, a famous drag racer plots to steal his car and enter a race independently.

item.title: Pit Stop (aka The Winner)
item.description: A brash drag racer gets a chance to prove himself as a driver but being a winner may cost him everything.

item.title: Bus Stop
item.description: A naive cowboy kidnaps a saloon singer with whom he's infatuated.

item.title: Perry Mason: The Case of the Sinister Spirit
item.description: A publisher is charged with the murder of a horror writer at a `haunted' hotel, but Perry's investigation reveals a more ghostly culprit.

item.title: Midnight Clear
item.description: American and German soldiers tired of the war come to an agreement to avoid fighting, but a tragic misunderstanding will change everything.

item.title: D-Day The Sixth of June
item.description: On their way to war, an American and a British officer remember their love, not realizing it's the same woman.

item.title: Guadalcanal Diary
item.description: A war correspondent takes us through the preparations, landing and initial campaign on Guadalcanal during WWII.

item.title: The Long Voyage Home
item.description: During WWII, a merchant ship grows weary dealing with their time at sea, their dangerous cargo, and the threat of a Nazi spy.

item.title: The Razor's Edge
item.description: An adventuresome young man goes off to find himself and loses his socialite fiancée in the process. But when he returns 10 years later, she will stop at nothing to get him back, even though she is already married.

item.title: Go For Broke
item.description: The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II.
